name: Chantal Ah Young
title: Psychologist
description: Experience supporting clients with anxiety, trauma, dissociation, OCD and grief. Particular interest in working with women experiencing complex trauma, structural dissociation, and OCD presentations, recognising the different 'parts' that shape a person's wellbeing. Chantal is LGBTQIA+ affirming and neuro-affirming.
specialties: structural dissociation, complex trauma, parts work, OCD, LGBTQIA+ affirming

name: Soraya Khan
title: Senior Counsellor (Mental Health Social Worker)
description: Particularly passionate about helping clients heal from trauma and PTSD; has completed specialised training in trauma counselling and EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing).

name: Michelle Thomson
title: Director & Principal Psychologist
description: For over 17 years she has focussed her work on sexual addictions, infidelity and betrayal; works with pornography and sexual addiction and sexual and intimacy concerns with individuals and couples.
specialties: sexual addiction, sexual and intimacy concerns, infidelity, couples
